name: Exp_LinearRegSlope_V1
summary: This EA trades based on the Linear Regression Slope indicator, opening buy positions when the slope crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below. It uses customizable smoothing methods and price types, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management parameters. The strategy is a systematic trend-following system that enters in the direction of the linear regression slope crossover.
summary_zh: 该EA基于线性回归斜率指标进行交易，当斜率上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿时开空仓。它支持多种平滑算法和价格类型，并具有可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理参数。该策略是一个系统性的趋势跟踪系统，按照线性回归斜率交叉方向入场。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：该EA使用线性回归斜率（LinearRegSlope_V1）指标来判断市场趋势方向，斜率为正表示上升趋势，斜率为负表示下降趋势。入场条件：当上轨线（UpValue）在上一根K线高于下轨线（DnValue）且当前K线发生交叉（UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0]）时触发买入信号；当下轨线高于上轨线且发生反向交叉时触发卖出信号。出场条件：买入信号触发时同时平掉卖出仓位，卖出信号触发时同时平掉买入仓位；此外还有独立的止损和止盈机制。仓位管理：使用MoneyManagement（MM）参数控制仓位大小，负值表示风险百分比模式，支持固定手数或比例仓位。资金管理：通过MM参数实现，默认-0.1表示使用风险百分比计算仓位，止损和止盈分别默认为1000和2000点。信号在每根新K线生成时计算，使用SignalBar参数控制信号延迟，并通过Recount机制确保数据可靠性。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: This EA uses the Linear Regression Slope indicator to determine market trend direction, with positive slope indicating an uptrend and negative slope indicating a downtrend. Entry conditions: A buy signal is triggered when the upper line (UpValue) was above the lower line (DnValue) on the previous bar and a crossover occurs on the current bar (UpValue[0]<=DnValue[0]); a sell signal is triggered when the lower line was above and a reverse crossover occurs. Exit conditions: A buy signal simultaneously closes sell positions, and a sell signal simultaneously closes buy positions; additionally, there are independent stop-loss and take-profit mechanisms. Position sizing: The MoneyManagement (MM) parameter controls lot size, with negative values indicating risk percentage mode, supporting both fixed lots and proportional sizing. Money management: Implemented via the MM parameter, default -0.1 means using risk percentage to calculate position size, with default stop-loss and take-profit of 1000 and 2000 points respectively. Signals are calculated on each new bar using the SignalBar parameter for signal delay, and a Recount mechanism ensures data reliability when CopyBuffer fails.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，负值为风险百分比模式
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot

pros: 使用线性回归斜率指标，具有统计学基础，比简单均线更科学
支持10种平滑算法和11种价格类型，灵活性高
具有对冲冲突信号处理机制（同时出现买卖信号时取消所有信号）
内置新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线重复交易
支持独立的买卖开仓和平仓开关，灵活性好
pros_en: Uses linear regression slope indicator with a statistical foundation, more scientific than simple moving averages
Supports 10 smoothing algorithms and 11 price types, offering high flexibility
Has conflicting signal handling mechanism (cancels all signals when buy and sell signals appear simultaneously)
Built-in new bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading on the same bar
Supports independent buy/sell open and close switches for flexible control
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值过大，在非H4周期上风险较高
没有点差过滤，可能在点差较大时产生虚假信号
缺乏仓位存在检查，可能重复开仓
指标依赖外部自定义指标LinearRegSlope_V1，增加了部署复杂性
没有最大持仓或最大回撤限制机制
cons_en: Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large, posing high risk on non-H4 timeframes
No spread filter, which may generate false signals during high-spread conditions
Lacks existing position check, potentially opening duplicate positions
Depends on external custom indicator LinearRegSlope_V1, increasing deployment complexity
No maximum position or maximum drawdown limit mechanism
improvements: 添加点差过滤机制，避免在点差过大时入场
增加持仓检查逻辑，防止同一方向重复开仓
添加最大回撤保护和最大持仓数量限制
improvements_en: Add a spread filter mechanism to avoid entering during excessively wide spreads
Add position existence check logic to prevent duplicate openings in the same direction
Add maximum drawdown protection and maximum position count limits

risk_points: 止损止盈点数默认值较大，在小周期上可能造成严重亏损
没有点差过滤，高波动时段滑点可能超出预期
缺少持仓检查可能导致重复开仓增加风险敞口
risk_points_en: Large default stop-loss/take-profit values may cause significant losses on smaller timeframes
No spread filter means slippage during high-volatility periods may exceed expectations
Lack of position check may lead to duplicate openings increasing risk exposure

The strategy is a systematic trend-following system that enters in the direction of the linear regression slope crossover.
